readout_other: Randall Selitto paw pressure; modified Hargreaves thermal latency; hindpaw extension (startle) and flexion (grasp) scoring; light microscopy and transmission electron microscopy of sciatic nerve
direction_notes: FUS to the sciatic nerve before hindpaw incision raised mechanical thresholds for 2 weeks and thermal thresholds for at least 4 weeks and reduced hindpaw flexion and extension, versus sham and incision-only controls.
safety_notes: Mean peak nerve temperature 57.1 and 61.4 C (thermal dose 21,005 CEM43); myelin and axon structural alterations at the FUS site on light and electron microscopy 14 days after FUS; transient motor deficit.

exposures.label: FUS applied directly to exposed rat sciatic nerve, two 8 s pulse trains 2 min apart

timing.protocol_description: FUS was applied in a pulse train, where each 25 ms pulse was followed by 25 ms off, for a duty cycle of 50%. Applied once as two 8 s trains 2 min apart at 1.86 then 1.97 MPa peak-to-peak.
